findings.title: Initialize temporal history when a single-frame view starts accumulating
findings.scenario: Render a static view with accumulate=1: accumulating=false, so only resolved is displayed while frames becomes1 and history is untouched. Raise only target to8: target is absent from RenderedView and same stays true, so next_weight=1/2 blends the second frame against unwritten (or stale) history. Reported sample2 represents only one valid accumulated image, darkening the mean. The same gap exists in the parent and remains in this affected policy/history family.
findings.proof: RenderedView fields frame_state.rs8-20 exclude history validity; same/reset mod1718-1723, accumulating branch1963-2009, frames increment2045; post.wgsl accumulate_fs loads before and mix(before,now,weight).
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Track validity/source of the actual history or reset/promote correctly when entering temporal accumulation from a resolved-only output. Preserve ordinary increased targets on an already valid mean and moving temporal behavior.
findings.acceptance: A finite still view rendered once without accumulation and then requested at multiple samples has a valid mean and accurate sample count; stale/unwritten history is never weighted as a prior sample. Existing tests only; no new cases requested.

findings.title: Preserve the coarser resident prefix at a capped strand transition
findings.scenario: Two adjacent strand bands both select logical count1000; higher-point finer resident is capped at100 and coarser resident at200 by upload_level storage limit. At finer lower edge amount=1, new population(outgoing) returns100, so incoming coarse draw is0..100. Immediately below edge its own coarse band draws0..200. Parent split logical prefix1000 first then clamped each draw to its own resident capacity, reaching0..200 continuously. Normal unequal point-count levels can trigger this new discontinuity.
findings.proof: draws.rs population closure43-47 invokes draw_gpu, whose count is clamped at141; strands-to-strands branch72 uses that outgoing count for incoming endpoint. render1937 clamps again per target; upload_level1133-1140 allows different capacities by point count.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Define the shared logical transition prefix and bound each native draw against its own resident population without letting the finer capacity truncate the coarser endpoint. Coordinate canonical producer counts; preserve native-width safety and existing valid numerical transitions.
findings.acceptance: At amount1 the incoming coarser prefix agrees with the coarser band immediately below, including unequal capacities; no usize-to-u32 wrap, inverted range or out-of-resident draw.
